items.title: Math Department Tutor
items.org: The Cooper Union for the Advancement of Science and Art
bullets: Provide individualized tutoring to undergraduate students with a focus on developing long-term learning strategies and confidence in tackling advanced math coursework
Facilitate drop-in support sessions in a math help room, addressing spontaneous questions and adapting explanations to diverse learning styles
Build a rapport with students, acting as both tutor and mentor to support their academic and personal development

items.title: BE in Mechanical Engineering
items.org: The Cooper Union for the Advancement of Science and Art
items.details: Completed coursework in statics and engineering design. Coursework in dynamics, materials science, mechanics of materials, basics of electrical engineering, systems engineering, and thermodynamics to be completed before Summer 2026. To participate in the solar decathlon project in Spring 2026. Half-tuition scholarship plus a $5000 annual Innovator Scholarship.

items.title: Bridgewater Raritan High School
items.details: Coursework in CAD, CNC, interior design, micro- and macroeconomics. Graduated top 5% of class with a 3.98 unweighted GPA. Received the President's Award for Educational Excellence, Student of the Month award, and National Merit Letter of Commendation.
